tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Silver paper by day, slate at night.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, the register table, the check chain, inputs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around panels. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and quiet-button borders, the unpassed check thread. At least 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper and paper-raised. Fill of the primary button. The logo's ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, relative times, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (primary button).

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Sealing-wax red. Only for seals, stamps and the market's mark of commitment. Never for errors, links or decoration. Text in it reads on paper, paper-raised and seal-soft.

tokens.name: seal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an open or disputed status stamp.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Glitnir gold. Only for what is verified or final: passed checks, the final seal, the Verified summary. Text in it reads on paper, paper-raised and gold-soft.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Disc of a final seal, ground of the Verified summary and the Final stamp.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: A check that failed or an error. Always with the word Failed or an x mark, never by color alone. Kept apart from seal by being lighter and more orange.

tokens.name: fail-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error message or a failed summary.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface.

styles.name: answer
styles.usage: The verdict word, once per market page.

styles.name: question-xl
styles.sample: Is the air in Berlin above 3 °C?
styles.usage: The question on a market page.

styles.name: question
styles.sample: Will Berlin be above 5 °C at noon on 20 November?
styles.usage: Questions in the register and in cards.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, check lines, captions under controls.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status stamps and table headers. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: evidence
styles.usage: A line quoted from a source, exactly as the judge saw it.

styles.name: hash
styles.usage: Hashes, keys and transaction ids. Only inside For auditors.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a stamp's mark and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact rows, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of stamps and inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of panels on phones, minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of panels, gap between level-one blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between the case column and the check column.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space above the page footer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and the evidence quote.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and messages.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels: the register, the check chain, Ask the judge.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status stamps. Seals are true circles and need no radius.
